verdict.rationale: The IP practice page documents patent prosecution as a core named practice, citing foundational patents prosecuted for major tech clients (GoPro, Facebook, Twitter, Venmo) and a 'Firm of the Year - Nationwide for Patent Prosecution and IP Transactions' award, alongside portfolio strategy support via trademark extranet and AI-assisted drafting tools. Missing for 10: named individual practitioner bios/attorney pages specifically tied to patent prosecution (only group-level practice page evidence provided).
